title: RunInstructionsComposedPayload

runId.description: A run's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when the run starts or is adopted.

channel.description: The instruction channel of the account's adapter: none is handed no text.

layer.description: A layer of a run's standing instructions, in the order the text holds them: user (the orientation block, then owned instructions), team-bank, project, session, persona (a bot's), always-on (always-on skills).

characters.description: The characters the layer holds in the text: its parts, each two apart.

id.description: What the part is, within its layer: orientation for the orientation block, else the id of the thing it renders.

version.description: The version of what the part renders, where it has one (a catalogue entry's); null where it has none.

items.description: A part of a layer as the manifest names it: its id, its version, and its length in characters.

parts.description: The layer's parts, in the order the text holds them.

items.description: A layer of the composed text: which, the characters it holds there, and its parts.

layers.description: The layers the text holds, in their fixed order; a layer that gave nothing, or whose parts were all left out, is not listed.

origin.description: Where the skill comes from: its repository identity and folder; null for one with no known origin.

commit.description: The commit of the source snapshot it was read from; null for a member linked live (the own directory, a trusted repository).

items.description: An always-on skill the composition appended: its name, its origin and the commit it was read at.

alwaysOn.description: The always-on skills the text holds, in the order it holds them.

skillSetFingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the run's skill set; null while none is resolved for it.

unreadRegistries.description: The registries the orientation block could not read in time, each rendered as could not be read; empty when every one was read.

layer.description: A layer of a run's standing instructions, in the order the text holds them: user (the orientation block, then owned instructions), team-bank, project, session, persona (a bot's), always-on (always-on skills).

id.description: What the part is, within its layer: orientation for the orientation block, else the id of the thing it renders.

reason.description: Why a composed part is not in the text: channel-none (the account's adapter has no instruction channel, so it is handed no text).

items.description: A part the layers gave that the text does not hold, and why.

leftOut.description: The parts the layers gave that the text does not hold, each with why.

manifest.description: What a composition of standing instructions holds: the channel, per layer its parts' ids, versions and characters, the always-on skills with origins and commits, the skill set's fingerprint, the registries the orientation block could not read, and what was left out and why.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the composed text as UTF-8, which is never logged: two runs handed the same text have the same digest.

description: run.instructions.composed: the run's standing instructions were composed, once, after run.started and run.policy.resolved and before the provider's first event: the manifest and the text's digest, never the text.
